source_description: User-supplied strict pure no-fallback versus Ghidra scorecard summary
notes: This is a hash-pinned summary, not the missing original raw JSON report.
Approximate overall scores are compared at the precision reported by the source.
The original identity maps selected statically linked CRT functions for part of the corpus and were not linker-authoritative.
The original Ghidra exports were stale relative to the rebuilt PE fixtures.
These figures are retained as historical input but cannot be used as a release threshold. A comparable pre-change raw report or source snapshot is still required.
